# A pot left deliberately plain

Finished a plain glazed pot instead of adding the band I had sketched. It sits well beside the older bowls. [[Pottery]]: restraint is easier to admire after the object is finished than to choose while I can still change it. Keep the sketch as an alternative, not a debt owed by this pot.
